messages:
kai: Quick follow-up: I sketched a compact 'overlay-striping' approach for safetensors + stream sources. Goal: incremental hotpatches + low-latency warmup without full index dependency. Thoughts?
alyssa: Curious about atomicity and verification model. Can you paste the tiny sketch?
kai: Sketch: shards split into stripes. Base manifest + optional overlay manifests that list changed stripes. Loader composes manifests atomically at switch. Prefetch operates on stripe units.
ram: If overlay arrives mid-prefetch we risk mixing versions in memory. What's the pin model?
kai: Loader pins a manifest_epoch per activation. Prefetch checks epoch; if it sees a newer overlay it aborts and restarts against pinned epoch. Also expose ModelHandle.snapshot_epoch() for callers.
marie: Verification: streaming sources get cheap 64-bit stripe fingerprints for fast accept/reject. Full SHA256/signature runs async. If async fails we evict stripe and emit an alert.
ishaan: Add verify_mode: progressive|strict. Progressive = map on fingerprint and run full verify later; strict = block mapping until full verify. Default progressive for hosted/dedicated, strict for private.
alyssa: Memory: async verify + prefetch can blow slab. Suggest a stripe_token_pool bounded by volatile_memory_budget and max_pending_stripes to throttle prefetch.
ram: Upload strategy per stripe? We need hints for mmap vs staged upload for quantized/fused stripes.
kai: Add stripe.metadata.upload_hint = mmap|staged|direct. Loader honors when budget allows, else falls back to staged pool.
marie: Hotpatch rollback: keep previous manifest cached to revert quickly if overlay_apply fails validation. Emit overlay_apply_failures metric and rollback event.
ishaan: Metrics: stripe_fetch_latency, stripe_verify_failures, overlay_apply_failures, prefetch_throttled_count, progressive_verify_block_count. Add console charts and an alert when verify_failures > X in 5m.
kai: Runtime API: ModelLoader.open(manifest_ref) -> ModelHandle; ModelHandle.open_stripe(id) -> StripeStream with read_slice, pin_to_gpu, verify_sync. Also ModelHandle.snapshot_epoch().
alyssa: Tests: generate base+overlay sets and inject random stripe corruption; measure detection time under progressive vs strict.
ram: Rollout: start canary on dedicated pool, monitor verify_failures and evictions for 10 days, then opt-in beta for selected public models.
buildbot: CI queued: delta-overlay/stripe-proto (10 jobs).
kai: Action items: kai push PoC branch this week; ishaan prototype verifier microbench; alyssa add snapshot_epoch unit tests; marie draft rollback runbook; ram wire metrics to console. Ping here when PR up.
